text:
</sub>  Resolve the contradictory single-run output contract

The claim that the default `--runs 1` output remains identical cannot coexist with the later requirement that every run unconditionally gains cost, fixture, and configuration fields and is emitted as a per-run record. Existing callers also consume the current single `RecallBenchmarkSummary` shape, including `--previous-summary-file`, so an implementer cannot tell whether to preserve that contract or introduce the campaign record shape. Specify the backward-compatible envelope or explicitly migrate the existing consumers and tests.
